notes.title: Official Launch of The Alien Trials
notes.content:
I'm very proud to announce the release of [b]The Alien Trials[/b] with everyone here on Steam. I hope you enjoy this multiplayer experience and I appreciate any feedback in advance. 


https://store.steampowered.com/app/1492900/The_Alien_Trials/

So without further ado, let the best alien win.

Thanks for playing!
Heypid
